supersedes: g1_piston_v3_retrain_preregistration.json, whose run completed only 150 gradient updates and therefore did not test the fixes. That result is retained and reported as a throughput failure, not as evidence against the changes.

what_changed_from_run_1.utd: 0.5 -> 8 (measured 0.12% wall-clock overhead; 150 -> ~3000 updates in the same 3 hours)
what_changed_from_run_1.correlated_noise: NEW: exploration drawn as DCT coefficients rather than 900 i.i.d. scalars
what_changed_from_run_1.everything_else: unchanged: v3 reward, GAMMA_CHUNK 0.98, ACTION_BASIS, CRITIC_STATE, SMOOTH_LAMBDA 100, 22-episode v3 buffer

configuration.critic: reinitialised (input width changed); policy, log-std and alpha transfer

hypotheses.H1_critic_fits: With ~3000 updates rather than 150, critic_loss should stop diverging and settle. This is the precondition for any policy claim: SAC's actor maximises the critic, so an unfitted critic actively degrades the policy.
hypotheses.H2_no_repeat_of_the_collapse: Run 1 fell grasp 0.20 -> 0.00 monotonically. If that was the unfitted critic, grasp should NOT collapse this time.
hypotheses.H3_exploration_quality: Correlated noise cuts per-step exploration jitter 10.2x at the same scale, so the online data should resemble demonstration dynamics more closely and the measured oscillation should be lower at equal training.
hypotheses.H4_dispense: Still expected to stay 0.00. No executable demonstration contains a reproducible press, so the functional act must be discovered from reward alone. A nonzero dispense would be a genuine surprise, not the expected outcome.

decision_rules.primary: v3 stage rates on the frozen 25-condition suite, deterministic, n=25, warm-start vs retrained under the SAME predicate.
decision_rules.critic_health_is_reported_first: critic_loss trajectory is reported before any policy number. If it is still diverging, the run is declared another throughput/stability failure and NO claim is made about the reward or discount fixes.
decision_rules.progress: grasp or lift rising beyond the 8-run noise floor counts as progress; post-grasp metrics from a single evaluation carry the documented non-reproducibility caveat.
decision_rules.failure_is_reportable: Degradation or a flat result is reported as-is, with the mechanism identified if possible.
decision_rules.no_tuning_after_the_fact: v3 thresholds and the discount are fixed by measurement and will not be adjusted to improve the numbers.

risk_registered_in_advance: High UTD on a small buffer can overfit the critic. Mitigations already in place: RLPD's 50% demonstration replay and the 5x smaller critic input (41 transitions per input dimension, up from 8.2). If critic_loss rises monotonically this is the first suspect and will be named as such.
